title: 3 Bedroom Townhome w Private Suite!
description:
Welcome to The Leland by NashStay! Stretch out in this unique split-level townhome with a private suite just 2 miles from Broadway and 1 mile from Titans Stadium. Block-adjacent to the "5-points" block, home to many great foodie spots, a gym, yoga studios, concert venues, bars, and parks, all within just three blocks. You'll have endless options with four sleeping beds, three en-suite bathrooms, two half baths, a private office, and an entertaining roof deck with fantastic city skyline views.

The space
This modern East Nashville townhome offers a well-defined layout with multiple sleeping areas, private bathrooms, and a private rooftop deck, plus a separate ground-floor suite with its own entrance. The design works well for families, work groups, or friends traveling together who want a shared gathering space with added sleeping privacy.

⸻

🛏 Sleeping Arrangements

Upper-Level Main Living Space:
• Bedroom 1: Queen bed, private en-suite bathroom, Smart TV
• Bedroom 2: Adult queen bunk bed, private en-suite bathroom, Smart TV
• Living area with queen-size pull-out sleeper sofa

Ground-Floor Private Suite:
• Bedroom 3: King bed, Smart TV
• Living area with queen-size pull-out sleeper sofa
• Full private bathroom

All bedrooms include blackout curtains, quality linens, multiple pillows, and fresh towels.

⸻

🌇 Private Rooftop Deck (Exclusive Use)
The rooftop deck is separated from other units.

• 🔥 Gas fire pit
• 🍽 Dining table seating for six
• 🪑 Lounge seating with large sectional sofa
• 🛏 Daybed lounger
• 🥚 Egg swing chair
• 🎲 Rooftop games: golf put, large connect four, digital darts, small bean toss
• 📺 Smart TV
• 🍷 Indoor wet bar with wine/beverage chiller
• 🌈 Decorative accent lighting for evening use

⸻

🛋 Living & Gathering Spaces

• Upstairs living room with large sectional sofa
• Queen-size pull-out sleeper built into sectional
• 📺 86” Smart TV in the main living area
• Open layout designed for group seating and conversation

⸻

🍽 Kitchen & Dining

• Fully equipped kitchen with all standard appliances
• Gas range, oven, microwave, refrigerator
• Cookware, utensils, and cooking supplies provided
• ☕ Keurig + coffee pot combo (coffee provided)
• 🍽 Kitchen island seating for four
• 🍴 Dining table seating for six

⸻

💻 Home Office & Technology

• Dedicated private home office
• Large desk with computer peripherals
• Hardwired Ethernet connection
• ⚡ High-speed fiber internet
• 📺 Smart TVs in every bedroom and living space

⸻

🌡 Comfort & Climate
• Separate HVAC controls on each floor
• Allows guests to set individual comfort levels
• On-demand hot water system

⸻

🚪 Layout & Access 

This rental includes two separate entrances:
• Main entrance to the upper-level living space and rooftop deck
• Separate exterior entrance to the ground-floor private suite

Both spaces are part of the same reservation and are not internally connected, providing privacy while remaining exclusively reserved for your group.

⸻

🚗 Parking & Access

• Off-street parking available
• Free street parking nearby
• ⚡ EV charging available by reservation
• 🔑 Keyless smart-lock entry

⸻

📍 Location — East Nashville

• Walk to restaurants, bars, and live music venues
• 🏟 Nissan Stadium ~1 mile
• 🎶 Downtown Broadway ~2 miles
• ⛳ Top Golf ~5 minutes
• ✈ Easy access to major roads and airport

⸻

👥 Ideal For

• Families traveling together
• Friends sharing a rental with privacy needs
• Work trips or extended stays
• Guests who want both gathering space and separation

⸻

The Leland offers a thoughtfully designed layout, a fully private rooftop experience, and detailed amenities that make group stays comfortable, functional, and easy — all in one of East Nashville’s most walkable neighborhoods.

Do you have larger groups or need more beds? THE LELAND features four townhomes with a total of 15 rooms, ranging from single-bedroom rentals to four-bedroom, full-townhome units. Please feel free to contact me for group bookings, or check my profile to see other group listings.

✨✨✨ Stays of 5 nights or longer are up to 50% discounted! Ideal for families or corporations with temporary work assignments or relocation needs. Please inquire for longer-term requests. Prices are negotiable. ✨✨✨

Luggage drop-off is available for a $25 administrative fee.

NO parties or events are allowed, and only the number of guests listed with the reservation or occupancy limit is permitted at the property at any time. A photo ID of the primary guest staying must be provided if it differs from the booking guest. This property is monitored with exterior cameras, noise, and smoke monitors to verify compliance. No smoking or marijuana. 

** NO LOCALS **

No pets except for licensed house-broken service animals. Pets must be identified before arrival. Please clean up after your service animal to avoid additional pet cleaning fees.

Other things to note
Damage charges will be assessed against the deposit, insurance policy (if purchased), or as a payment request, depending on the platform booked. Fees will be assessed against the booking person who assumes responsibility for all guests during the reservation period. Fees are based on estimated management, call-out repair service costs, and overhead associated with restoring the house to the original condition of the home as received. 

	1. NO parties, events, or guests beyond the booking amount for any amount of time. Unauthorized parties or events or neighbor disturbances will result in cancellation of the booking without refund and, if required, removal by police. Maximum occupancy must be adhered to for safety and legal reasons. 
		a. $300 event fee per night when guests beyond capacity are invited over.
		b. Guests beyond the included occupancy limit will be assessed a nightly fee per person based on the listing settings.
	2. Neighbor noise complaints - $100 for the first complaint then booking cancellation. 
	3. Noise monitors are present on the premises. Quiet hours are from 10 pm on weekdays and 11 pm on weekends through 7 am. Close windows to prevent noise if there is music or loud voices. Maintain reasonable volume after hours inside and outside. Respect the neighbors, both neighboring townhome occupants and adjacent parcels! Sound does transmit through walls to the neighboring townhomes. Neighbors will contact me directly about nuisances or other issues. The soundbar volume should generally be at half volume maximum, and the subwoofer at half volume down for safe volume.
	4. Smoking monitors are present on the premises. No smoking any substance and no Vaping or e-cig indoors or near open entry - $300 ozone cleaning fee.
	5. Cigarette butt cleanup on premises (porches, decks yard) - $50
	6. NO Glitter, Confetti; party material clean up - $100 
	7. Paint or Drywall Damage (marks larger than 2 inches, or any gouge size) - $100 per damaged wall or cost
	8. Bodily Fluid Clean Up - $100 per incident
	9. Smells that do not diffuse within 3hr cleaning window - $100
	10. Staining/Ripping of Comforter - $100 (stains that do not come out in wash cycle)
	11. Staining/Ripping of Bed Sheets - $100 
	12. Staining/Missing Pillow - $50 
	13. Stained/Missing Bath Towels - $50 (do not bleach darks)
	14. Stained Couch - $100 (fabric cleaner is under sink - guest should remove visible stains caused immediately)
	15. Stained carpets - $75
	16. Missing Remote control for fans, lights, fireplace, soundbar, or TV - $50 fee
	17. Any Missing Kitchen Item - $25 Each 
	18. Scarred/Scratched Floors/Area rugs/Carpet - $100 min. up to replacement value
	19. Clogged toilet left - $50 (plungers provided)
	20. Plumbing Resulting from Anything Other Than Soap/Water Down Sink Drain - $100 
	21. Trash left anywhere on premises, roof deck, or yards not placed in proper trash cans at parking area - $100
	22. Missing gaming supplies and amenities - Replacement cost plus $25 fee.
	23. Fire extinguisher discharge for no reason - $100 + cleaning costs
	24. Rearranged furniture - $50 per room
	25. Additional cleaning fee - Per invoiced amount beyond standard cleaning fee purchased (where not identified here).
	26. Late Check Out - $100 for Every Hour Past Check Out time. Same day check-ins will not allow late check-out. The cleaning crew will arrive at checkout and begin cleaning work unless otherwise agreed with host.
	27. Any other damage, including furniture or game tables outdoors, is assessed at replacement value + $50 handling fee
	28. One off-street parking space allocated matching the assigned unit letter. Do not park in other spaces as they are assigned to other tenants. 
	29. No candles or fire on premises. 
	30. Unapproved pet - $100 deep cleaning. Unapproved pet remains: $50 per incident.
	31. $100 insurance claim handling fee anytime a claim is required to cover damages.
	

Roof Deck Rules:
	1. Minors (<18 yrs old) must have adult supervision at all times due to fall hazard and gas fire pit.
	2. Quiet hours must be observed between 10pm-7am every day (11pm on weekends). Respect the neighbors and adjoining townhomes! Keep TV and talking to respectable level.
	3. Use of fire pit or grill by adults only.
	4. FALL HAZARD! Do not stand, sit, lean on, or climb over any edge, ledge, or railing. This deck is 4 stories tall.
	5. Intoxicated persons or those not in sound mind should not be present on the deck.
	6. No fire except from the fire pit and/or grill.
	7. No throwing any object from the roof. 
	8. Secure TV cover when not in use, return remote to inside. 
	9. Secure fire pit cover (after cool down to touch) when finished using. Otherwise fold cover and store inside to prevent wind blowing away.
	10. Leave cushions secured on their seating velcro. If it becomes loose please do me a favor and tie it down or report any non-sticking velcro issues. Secure the cushion inside or a safe location before leaving.
	11. Leave hose disconnected and spigot OFF.
	12. Remove trash immediately to interior receptacle can at the wet bar.
	13. Do not allow trash or other items to fall into the deck cracks. The drainage system is underground and debris may cause backups.
	14. Note: High winds are often present at this altitude and location! Secure all cushions and items especially when not in use.
Natural Gas warning! Do not leave any natural gas pipe shutoff valve open (grill) or the fire pit valve ON without a flame. The gas shutoff valve for the fire pit is underneath a removable piece of deck wood at the front-center of the deck below the metal railing and under the deck seat. The gas shutoff for the grill is near the hose spigot by the door. If you smell natural gas (rotten egg smell) call Piedmont Emergency Nashville line and inform the host after exiting the premises.
